figures.definition_text: Sum of money received credited to any expense ledger.
Cash paid through Journal entries to any expense ledger.
Lowest best-case daily closing of cash ledger (tag d989b38f); zero when it never goes below zero.
Date of that lowest best-case closing (blank when none).
Days on which cash ledger (tag d989b38f) closes below zero even if every same-day receipt came before every same-day payment.
Days on which cash ledger (tag d989b38f) is below zero if same-day payments came first.

Sum of every ledger's Trial Balance opening balance (Dr positive). Without integrated inventory, Tally shows a non-zero sum as 'Difference in opening balances'; with it, the sum also leaves out the opening stock, and the difference in opening balances is the figure after opening stock.
The ledger openings' sum plus the opening stock: the difference in opening balances.
Opening stock on the stock items as at the Trial Balance's first day (Dr positive). Tally holds it on no ledger, so the ledger openings sum to minus it plus any difference in opening balances.
Number of Contra entries crediting cash whose bank narration names the assessee's own account (money received from another account, booked as cash deposited).
Contra entries crediting cash whose bank narration names the assessee's own account (money received from another account, booked as cash deposited).
Number of Contra entries debiting cash whose bank narration names the assessee's own account (money sent to another account, booked as cash in hand).
Contra entries debiting cash whose bank narration names the assessee's own account (money sent to another account, booked as cash in hand).
Own-account narration terms set for this client. Zero means the own-account check looked at nothing.
